title: ask semantics: -p background subagent

stimulus.prompt: Start the {{AGENT_PREFIX}}probe-reader agent in the background to run `touch marker-F4`, wait for it to finish, then reply done. Don't run anything yourself.

observations.description: The main thread never attempted `touch marker-F4` itself (a PreToolUse without agent_type), so the marker speaks for the agent.
marker-F4 doesn't exist: an ask never turns into an allow without a person.

status_rules.confirmed: the command did not run under a headless ask
status_rules.contradicted: the command ran under a headless ask
status_rules.inconclusive: the agent never attempted `touch marker-F4`, or the main thread attempted it itself; or A1 isn't confirmed for the same host version and install

notes: F5 (interactive ask) is in the operational QA checklist (AC-13), not a case file.
verify in T0: permission rule syntax in the templates (Bash(echo *), WebFetch(domain:...), mcp__...)

Attribution: observations about the agent match only payloads whose agent_type ends in probe-reader (script) or probe:probe-reader (plugin), so the main thread can't decide the case. It requires A1: the result is inconclusive unless A1 is confirmed for the same host version and install.
